params.1274: Get a weapon. Major Corothers can supply you if you do not have one.
params.1275: Open your inventory by clicking on the satchel icon on your sidebar menu.
params.1276: Click on the weapon in your inventory to equip it.
params.1277: To remove a wielded weapon, open your Worn Equipment screen and click on it in the paper doll.
params.2225: You can engage in melee combat with your bare fists and feet, but it's not particularly effective.
